resources.string: Suggested: the app’s own model (Qwen3.6 35B). It fits on your graphics card: full accuracy at full speed.

The app’s own model (22 GB) doesn’t fit on your graphics card, so about 9 GB of it runs on the processor. It is accurate but slow: about 3 seconds to filter a job and 26 seconds for an ATS review. Let free online AI handle job filtering and page reading, and keep this model for resume work.
Suggested: Qwen3 8B. Agrees with the app’s model on most AI filter answers; some ATS reviews fail.
Suggested: Qwen3 4B Instruct. Every answer usable, but ATS keyword matches run low.
This computer is too small for a good local model. An online model with your own key will do better.
Couldn’t read this computer’s memory, so no model is suggested.
24 GB+ graphics: the app’s model, full accuracy and speed
12–24 GB graphics, 32 GB+ memory: the app’s model, slow; online AI for the bulk
16 GB, 8 GB graphics: Qwen3 8B, 19 of 22 filter answers agree
8–16 GB, 4–6 GB graphics: Qwen3 4B Instruct, 17 of 22
Less: an online model with your own key
